summary.en: Located at the tip of Hengli Island in Guangzhou’s Nansha Pearl Bay, the project translates an Eastern landscape composition into a layered waterfront district. Its skyline and public realm bring the energy of a financial island together with a contemporary Lingnan sense of place.

summary.en: The 2021NJY-12 plot on Hengli Island combines commercial, workplace, and residential uses in a landscape-led complex. Conceived as an island gateway and waterfront oasis, it brings Lingnan urban life into an outward-looking benchmark for Pearl Bay.

summary.en: A service district for the International Collaborative Innovation Zone, bringing together talent housing, a cultural and sports centre, and an energy control centre. The 30,171-square-metre site is structured as a vertical neighbourhood that supports daily life, exchange, recreation, and public services for young innovation workers.

summary.zh: 设计保留原有街巷尺度、空间关系与重要节点，通过“镶嵌”式新建介入形成新旧对话。文化通廊连接英东大道、环市大道与公祠、天后古庙，并以玻璃、金属、清水混凝土结合青砖、瓦片与蚝壳墙，形成面向未来的“新岭南”语汇。
summary.en: The design preserves the scale, relationships, and key nodes of the existing lanes while introducing new buildings as tectonic insertions. Cultural corridors connect the main roads to ancestral landmarks, and contemporary materials are paired with blue brick, tiles, and oyster-shell walls to form a forward-looking New Lingnan language.

summary.zh: 项目以“漂浮在水岸的文体方舟”为意象，通过“三重水韵”组织自然与人文。液态流线构成蓝色水系与绿色廊道，波浪形金属幕墙模拟水波光影；主要建筑以架空方式保留原生植被，形成建筑生长于自然的场所体验。
summary.en: Conceived as a cultural and sports ark floating beside the water, the complex uses a three-part aquatic narrative to connect nature and community. Flowing blue and green networks meet wave-like metal façades, while raised building volumes preserve existing vegetation and appear to grow from the landscape.

zh.methodText: 建筑训练负责组织尺度、光线与动线；关卡设计把这些关系变成节奏、风险与选择。最终呈现的不只是效果图，而是空间决策如何影响体验。

en.heroIntro: Translating scale, circulation, sightlines, and sense of place into experiences players can read, choose, and remember.
en.visualNote: Visual assets can keep evolving while the interface remains stable for simple file replacement.
en.atlasTitle: Not a grid of cards, but three spatial entrances.
en.atlasIntro: Each entrance begins with a spatial question, then opens into drawings, models, play, and iteration.
en.methodTitle: One spatial mindset, two scales of design.
en.methodText: Architecture organizes scale, light, and circulation. Level design turns those relationships into pacing, risk, and choice. The work shows not only final images, but how spatial decisions change experience.

summary.zh: 建筑学硕士，具备空间规划、关卡设计与视觉表达基础。拥有 UE5 箱庭关卡 Demo 及六款 Game Jam 项目实践，负责过关卡白盒、近远程敌人行为规则、遭遇配置与原型验证；围绕敌人 AI 设计，参与蓝图与 C++ 实现，结合 AI 辅助推进原型迭代，协同程序、美术完成设计落地。业余时间 Coser，喜欢 ACG 文化，在 ACG 乐队中担任键盘手，有丰富 Live 演出经验。
summary.en: Master of Architecture with a foundation in spatial planning, level design, and visual communication. I have built UE5 sandbox levels and contributed to six Game Jam projects, covering blockouts, melee and ranged enemy behavior rules, encounter configuration, and prototype validation. I work on enemy AI with Blueprints and C++, use AI to accelerate iteration, and collaborate with programmers and artists to bring designs into production. Outside work, I enjoy cosplay and ACG culture, and perform as a keyboardist in an ACG band.

company.zh: 凯达环球建筑设计咨询有限公司 Aedas（深圳）

bullets.zh: 参与 10+ 建筑设计投标项目，统一项目投标文本、展板与多媒体内容的视觉风格表达，累计推动 4 个项目中标。
bullets.en: Contributed to 10+ architectural design bids, unifying the visual language of bid documents, boards, and multimedia content; helped drive four projects to win.

bullets.zh: 将 Stable Diffusion、ComfyUI 等 AI 工作流融入概念方案与意向表达，前期视觉产出效率提升 80% 以上，并提升跨部门沟通效率。
bullets.en: Integrated Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI, and related AI workflows into concept development and intent communication, improving early-stage visual output efficiency by over 80% and streamlining cross-team communication.

bullets.zh: 参与概念方案推演与三维空间验证，能够从平面关系快速转化为空间布局、视觉方案与沉浸式场景表达。
bullets.en: Contributed to concept development and 3D spatial validation, translating plan relationships into spatial layouts, visual studies, and immersive scene expressions.

bullets.zh: 与建筑效果图团队协作，输出视觉参考并沟通镜头、材质等关键要求，保障渲染成果与项目创意方向一致。
bullets.en: Worked with architectural visualization teams on visual references, camera direction, and material requirements to keep rendered results aligned with the project's creative direction.

company.zh: 深圳市建筑设计研究总院（院士创作室）

bullets.zh: 围绕场地条件与使用需求进行体块和空间方案推敲，产出 10 余种比选方案供团队讨论，支持后续深化方向选择。
bullets.en: Developed massing and spatial options around site conditions and user needs, producing more than ten alternatives for team discussion and downstream design development.

bullets.zh: 参与建筑概念方案、平剖面设计与三维模型验证，使用 Rhino、Grasshopper 推敲体块、尺度和空间布局，支持团队评审、跨专业沟通及设计深化。
bullets.en: Contributed to architectural concepts, plans, sections, and 3D model validation; used Rhino and Grasshopper to study massing, scale, and spatial layout for reviews, cross-discipline communication, and design development.

title.zh: 《核心回响》 | 半线性箱庭重力解谜

context.zh: 3D 半线性开放 / 解谜 / 战斗。基于 UE5 开发第三人称半线性箱庭，以空间探索与重力解谜为核心体验，穿插战斗。
context.en: 3D semi-linear open exploration / puzzle / combat. A third-person semi-linear sandbox built in UE5, centered on spatial exploration and gravity puzzles with combat woven into the experience.

bullets.zh: 负责箱庭关卡整体体验流程、玩法与交互物件落地，参与蓝图与 C++ 实现，结合 AI 辅助推进原型迭代。
bullets.en: Owned the sandbox level flow, gameplay, and interactive objects, contributing to Blueprint and C++ implementation and using AI to accelerate prototype iteration.

bullets.zh: 围绕追击、朝向防御和远程压制划分敌人职责，以蓝图模板与 C++ 行为组件状态机承载决策，设计攻击条件、恢复窗口及玩家反制。
bullets.en: Defined enemy roles around pursuit, directional defense, and ranged suppression, using Blueprint templates and a C++ behavior-component state machine to structure decisions, attack conditions, recovery windows, and player counterplay.

bullets.zh: 规划十个区域与多层回环路径，设计三类重力机制，从单机制教学递进到组合解谜。
bullets.en: Planned ten areas with multi-level loops and designed three gravity mechanics that progress from single-mechanic teaching to combined puzzles.

bullets.zh: 制作关卡平面图、精细白盒与 Sequencer 过场，交付可运行 Demo、设计文档与实机演示。
bullets.en: Produced level plans, detailed blockouts, and Sequencer cinematics; delivered a playable demo, design documentation, and an in-game presentation.

bullets.zh: 项目参加 2026 清华 x 米哈游空间交互竞赛预赛。
bullets.en: The project entered the 2026 Tsinghua x miHoYo Spatial Interaction Competition preliminary round.

title.zh: 《月亮 The Moon》 | 复古科幻 FPS

context.zh: 3D 半线性开放 / FPS 射击

bullets.zh: 基于 Godot 开发半线性复古科幻 FPS，以高速移动中的战斗、生存与突围为核心体验；玩家可投掷飞刀并传送至落点，同时应对靠近后会隐身的敌人。
bullets.en: Designed a semi-linear retro sci-fi FPS in Godot around fast-moving combat, survival, and escape; players throw knives to teleport while responding to enemies that turn invisible at close range.

bullets.zh: 负责关卡策划，以及近战、远程怪物的行为 AI 设计、原型验证与玩法配置。
bullets.en: Owned level design, behavior AI design for melee and ranged enemies, prototype validation, and gameplay configuration.

bullets.zh: 使用 TrenchBroom 搭建关卡白盒，将飞刀落点、探索路径与战斗位置结合，让移动位置直接服务于战斗决策。
bullets.en: Built the level blockout in TrenchBroom, connecting knife landing points, exploration routes, and combat positions so movement choices directly support combat decisions.

bullets.zh: 结合近战、远程敌人的行为差异与隐形敌人规则，组织威胁辨认、交战与转移的节奏；项目进入最终展出版本。
bullets.en: Structured the rhythm of threat recognition, engagement, and repositioning around melee/ranged behavior differences and invisible-enemy rules; the level and monster design reached the final exhibition build.

title.zh: 《游光》 | 箱庭解谜 RPG

context.zh: 3D 半线性开放 / 解谜 / 探索

bullets.zh: 基于 Godot 开发 3D 箱庭探索游戏，以灯光解谜为核心体验；主流程线性推进，局部设置隐藏分支与支线奖励。
bullets.en: Developed a 3D sandbox exploration game in Godot around light-based puzzles, with a linear main flow and hidden branches with side rewards.

bullets.zh: 负责箱庭关卡整体体验流程与空间设计，在统一通关目标下提供多条探索路径。
bullets.en: Owned the sandbox level flow and spatial design, providing multiple exploration routes toward one clear completion goal.

bullets.zh: 通过灯光谜题、隐藏分支与奖励布局，让玩家在推进主线和绕行探索之间取舍；项目参与 TapTap Game Jam 2025 并在 TapTap 展示。
bullets.en: Used light puzzles, hidden branches, and reward placement to create trade-offs between mainline progress and detours; entered TapTap Game Jam 2025 and was showcased on TapTap.

role.zh: 关卡策划兼 UI 美术

bullets.zh: 基于 Unity 开发融合扫雷判断与宝藏探索的 2D 解谜游戏，以线索推理和风险取舍为核心体验。
bullets.en: Built a 2D puzzle game in Unity combining Minesweeper-like judgment with treasure exploration, centered on clue reasoning and risk trade-offs.

bullets.zh: 在 48 小时 Game Jam 中负责关卡设计、玩法配置及 UI 美术，完成由易到难的 5 张递进关卡。
bullets.en: Handled level design, gameplay configuration, and UI art in a 48-hour Game Jam, delivering five progressively difficult levels.

bullets.zh: 与团队完成 GGJ 2026 深圳站参赛作品，并在 Global Game Jam 展示。
bullets.en: Completed the GGJ 2026 Shenzhen entry with the team and showcased it on Global Game Jam.

bullets.zh: 基于 Unity 开发 AI 实时生成角色回复的 2D 文字冒险游戏，以 NPC 互动与多结局故事为核心体验。
bullets.en: Developed a 2D text adventure in Unity with AI-generated character replies, centered on NPC interaction and branching endings.

bullets.zh: 负责 NPC 性格与对话风格设计，参与角色美术及界面交互设计，让角色差异体现在交流与视觉表现中。
bullets.en: Designed NPC personalities and dialogue styles, contributing to character art and interface interaction so character differences appear in both conversation and visuals.

bullets.zh: 将多位 NPC 的性格、语言风格整理为 JSON，交付程序接入 DeepSeek，作为角色实时回应玩家的依据。
bullets.en: Structured NPC personalities and language styles as JSON for engineering integration with DeepSeek as the basis for real-time responses.

bullets.zh: 搭建根据玩家选择及 MBTI 性格生成头像的 ComfyUI 工作流 SOP，制作角色原画与界面交互原型。
bullets.en: Created a ComfyUI workflow SOP for avatar generation from player choices and MBTI traits, along with character art and interaction prototypes.

bullets.zh: 交付 NPC 配置、角色生成 SOP 及交互原型；项目参与机核 BOOOM Game Jam 2025，并在机核展示。
bullets.en: Delivered NPC configuration, a character-generation SOP, and an interaction prototype; entered BOOOM Game Jam 2025 and was showcased on Gcores.
